articles.title: When Catherine Zeta-Jones Told Michael Douglas She Wanted to Be Monogamous, He Had to Break It Off with 5 Other Women
articles.summary: The actor recalls the moment his future wife gave him an ultimatum early in their relationship
articles.body:
Michael Douglas says Catherine Zeta-Jones gave him an ultimatum early in their relationship

He was newly separated from Diandra Douglas and dating five women in different cities

Douglas and Zeta-Jones married in 1999 and share two children together

Michael Douglas had a few calls to make when Catherine Zeta-Jones made it clear she wasn't interested in sharing him.

In his new memoir, One Helluva Ride , Douglas, 82, looks back on the early days of his relationship with Zeta-Jones, 57, and reveals that the actress wasn't interested in becoming another relationship in his rotation. If he wanted to be with her, she made it clear, he had to be with her exclusively.

"She told me she understood that I was a single guy who'd come out of a long marriage, but she would only be monogamous," Douglas writes. "'I'm not interested in dating you if you're dating other people. You can either continue with them or end it and be with me.'"

Douglas had a pretty simple response, though he needed a minute — or, more specifically, five phone calls.

"I told her wait here I have to make five quick calls. 'Five? You have to make five calls?'" he recalls.

At the time, Douglas was still newly separated from his first wife, Diandra Douglas , whom he split from in 1995. He had been seeing five other women, though he says he viewed the arrangement as relatively straightforward.

"Just after my marriage, I had been seeing five other women. They knew I was recently separated and in the process of getting a divorce," he writes. "I made sure they all lived in different cities, which felt like a respectful way to be non-monogamous."

According to Douglas, none of the women had asked him for something more serious or even questioned whether he was seeing anyone else.

"None of them asked for a commitment or even asked what else I was up to. I am sure they were seeing other people, too," he writes.

But once Zeta-Jones made her position clear, Douglas knew what he wanted to do.

"That day, I called each one to say I met somebody and would no longer be able to continue seeing them. They all took it well," he writes.

And just like that, five relationships were over and Douglas was all in on Zeta-Jones.

One Helluva Ride doesn't shy away from the romantic chapters that came before Douglas' life with Zeta-Jones. He writes candidly about his past affairs, including romantic entanglements with his Romancing the Stone costar Kathleen Turner and Basic Instinct costar Jeanne Tripplehorn .

By the time he met Zeta-Jones, however, Douglas was already completely smitten. He first saw her in an early screening of her 1998 film The Mask of Zorro , then happened to cross paths with her a few weeks later at the Deauville American Film Festival in France while he was promoting A Perfect Murder .

He asked his publicist to arrange a meeting over drinks, and he quickly found himself impressed by more than her beauty.

"She was smart, funny, unpretentious, and, yes, breathtakingly beautiful. She just seemed so confident and self-assured, too," Douglas recalls in the book.

Later, after a dinner with Zeta-Jones and her Zorro costar Antonio Banderas and his then-wife Melanie Griffith , Douglas was even more taken with her. There was just one problem: He admits he was "smashed" by the end of the night.

As he walked Zeta-Jones to the hotel elevator to say good night, Douglas blurted out what would become one of his most memorable lines: "I'm going to be the father of your children."

"It wasn't a cheap pickup line. It was the truth," he writes.

The pair went on to marry in 1999 and have two children, Dylan, 26, and Carys, 23 . Douglas also shares son Cameron , 47, with Diandra, 70.

Nearly 26 years later, Douglas' relationship with Zeta-Jones has only grown deeper.

"There's just an unknown at a certain point over time," he tells PEOPLE. "It goes beyond being attracted to somebody in this matter. It's just an unknown bond of being close and… a mutual respect."

One Helluva Ride by Michael Douglas is available now, wherever books are sold.

articles.title: Shia LaBeouf’s wife Mia Goth files for divorce amid his legal turmoil
articles.summary: The two actors were married in 2016
articles.body:
Mia Goth has filed for divorce from Shia LaBeouf after 10 years of marriage, citing irreconcilable differences, and is seeking primary custody of their daughter Isabel.

The divorce filing comes after LaBeouf's ex-girlfriend, FKA twigs, settled a lawsuit against him, allowing her to speak freely about her alleged experiences of sexual abuse during their relationship.

LaBeouf is currently on probation after pleading guilty to misdemeanor battery charges following a drunken brawl in New Orleans, and has expressed regret for his past mistakes in his relationship with Goth.

Mia Goth has filed for divorce from Shia LaBeouf after 10 years of marriage.

The Pearl star, 32, filed the papers Tuesday night and cited "irreconcilable differences" as the reason, according to TMZ .

Although they have been legally married since October 2016, the former couple had a turbulent on-and-off relationship in the public eye for over a decade. After Goth and LaBeouf met on the set of Nymphomaniac: Vol. II in 2012, they tied the knot in Las Vegas in 2016 and broke up two years later. They then reconciled around 2020 and welcomed their daughter, Isabel, in 2022. Their date of separation is listed on the documents as July 28, 2025.

Goth is asking for primary legal and physical custody of Isabel, and is requesting to terminate the court's ability to award spousal support to either of the actors.

The Independent has reached out to representatives for Goth and LaBeouf for comment.

News of the filing comes just one day after LaBeouf's ex-girlfriend, singer FKA twigs, settled a lawsuit against the 40-year-old Megalopolis actor , meaning she is now free to speak about her alleged experiences of sexual abuse with him.

The lawsuit was settled after LaBeouf agreed to end the nondisclosure provisions from the former couple's settlement in December 2025.

Their long legal fight started in 2020, when Twigs accused LaBeouf of being sexually, mentally and physically abusive throughout their relationship, which lasted for about nine months in 2018. LaBeouf denied the allegations at the time.

The singer's attorney, Mathew Rosengart, said Wednesday in a statement shared with The Independent : "On the heels of Mr. LaBeouf's now dismissed, failed December 2025 arbitration against Twigs in which he sought money from her, this important victory completely frees her to discuss her experience, advocate for other women who might be less privileged, and freely support the charitable causes of her choice, which she was previously blocked from doing. To her great credit, Twigs stood up for something larger than herself, all female survivors of sexual abuse."

LaBeouf's attorney, Shawn Holley, said that the former Disney Channel star "wishes Twigs nothing but the best in her life and career and, to that end, has agreed to end their long-standing dispute."

"Twigs has spoken about this matter for years and there is now nothing to prevent her from continuing to do so," Holley told The Independent . She refused to comment on Goth's filing.

LaBeouf is currently on probation after he was arrested after getting into a drunken brawl in New Orleans in February. He pleaded guilty to misdemeanor battery charges in June and was sentenced to two years' probation, rehabilitation for alcohol abuse, sensitivity training and anger management classes.

The actor had moved to the Louisiana city after his separation from Goth, Page Six reported at the time.

In March, he spoke about his breakup with Goth in an interview on Channel 5 With Andrew Callaghan.

"We were deeply unhappy," LaBeouf said. "I made a lot of mistakes early on before we tried to have a baby. I had violated trust in a big, big way."

He said that their problems were "impossible" to fix, but that he still had love and respect for Goth. "We're in a good spot. I mean, this isn't new," he said. "We've been there for a while, we're trying to figure out co-parenting, and we're good. Even through all this, she gives me grace."

The national domestic abuse helpline offers support for women on 0808 2000 247, or you can visit the Refuge website. There is a dedicated men's advice line on 0808 8010 327. articles.title: Before Hollywood and global fame, Jennifer Lopez once slept at dance studio while pursuing her career: ‘I was homeless before I got famous'
articles.summary: Discover Jennifer Lopez's inspiring story of overcoming homelessness at 18 while pursuing her dreams in dance and acting, ultimately leading her to become a global superstar with a net worth of $400 million. Learn about her early struggles, family dynamics, and breakthrough roles in her rise to fame.
articles.body: Jennifer Lopez’s early career transition from the Bronx to Hollywood involved a period of sacrifice that she later described as being technically homeless. The singer and actress came from a middle-class background and worked her way up in the industry step by step; however, there was a brief time period when she had to stay in a dance studio to make ends meet.Jennifer Lopez once stayed in a dance studioDuring one of her old interviews with W Magazine, the singer opened up about how she faced homelessness at one point in her life when she was 18 years old. She shared, "I was homeless before I got famous. I was homeless.” She added that she and her mother fought about her future a lot and that her mother did not really support her decision to pursue the entertainment industry. While Lopez wanted to dance, her mother wanted her to go to college and get an education. The two fought too much to the point where Lopez revealed during the interview that she had to move out of her home. "My mom and I butted heads. I didn't want to go to college—I wanted to try dance full-time. So she and I had a break," she shared. Lopez added, “I told her, ‘This is what I have to do.'"Unable to stay at her parents' house and lacking the funds to rent a place in New York City, Lopez often slept on the sofa in her Manhattan dance studio. During the day, she would take intensive dance classes and go to auditions and later would return to sleep on the studio couch after hours.Jennifer Lopez’s big breakHer IG break came within the same year and helped her rise to the top. She first landed a job dancing in Europe in a production of Golden Musicals of Broadway and later toured Japan too. When she returned home, she booked ‘In Living Color’ and became one of the Fly Girls. However, this resulted in her leaving NYC for Los Angeles.Jennifer Lopez credits her parents for her successDespite the differences between her and her mother, Lopez still credited her parents as the reason why she worked so hard and actually made it in the industry. During the interview she opened up about how hard her parents used to work to make ends meet and to make sure that she had a good life growing up, which is what she applied to her work.Jennifer Lopez’s net worthAccording to Celebrity Net Worth, the singer and actress has an overall net worth of USD 400 million. From the Bronx to becoming one of the top stars in the Hollywood industry, Lopez has surely come a long way. After ‘In Living Color,' the star rose to fame after starring as Tejano singer Selena Quintanilla in 'Selena,' which earned her widespread acclaim and established her as a leading actress. She also appeared in ‘Out of Sight,' ‘The Wedding Planner,' and ‘Maid in Manhattan,' to name a few.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Zendaya’s rise to fame: How ‘Euphoria’ and ‘Spider-Man’ cemented the star as a rising force in the Hollywood industry
articles.summary: Explore Zendaya's incredible journey from her early beginnings in theater to her rise as a Hollywood A-lister, marked by iconic roles in 'Euphoria' and 'Spider-Man', and her relationship with Tom Holland.
articles.body: Zendaya, born Zendaya Maree Stoermer Coleman on September 1, 1996, has become one of the most successful stars in the Hollywood industry presently. From child star to Hollywood A-lister, she turned her life around and has now worked with the likes of Matt Damon, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson, Hugh Jackman, Javier Bardem, Rebecca Ferguson, Josh Brolin, and many others. Here is a look at her start in the industry along with her rise to one of the biggest stars in the Hollywood industry.Zendaya’s early lifeZendaya’s upbringing was heavily rooted in theater and acting, all thanks to her mother. While growing up in Oakland, California, her mother used to work as the house manager at the California Shakespeare Theater in Orinda. This is where the actress spent most of her childhood helping out, studying acting, and training in hip-hop dance groups and local theater productions, which all helped hone her skills in the arts.As for her education, she attended the Oakland School for the Arts and spent her time performing in Shakespearean plays like ‘Twelfth Night’ and ‘Richard III.' She also started working as a child model and commercial actor at the time, before she and her family moved to Los Angeles to give her career in showbiz a better chance.Zendaya’s breakthrough as child actressShe scored her breakthrough roles around 2013, landing her role as Rocky Blue alongside Bella Thorne on the teen show ‘Shake It Up.' This helped her solidify her footing in the industry and helped her also explore music as a profession. She also released her self-titled debut pop album in 2013, featuring the hit single ‘Replay.’Her next big project came with ‘Dancing with the Stars,’ where she finished as the runner-up at age 16. She was the youngest contestant at the time. She later returned to acting to star in and produce ‘K.C. Undercover,' one of her first roles as a producer.Zendaya’s film debut with ‘Spider-Man’In 2018, she finally scored her leading role in the film ‘Spider-Man: Homecoming’ opposite Tom Holland. The film was a massive success and launched the star right into global stardom. Around the same time, she also starred with Zac Efron in the hit musical ‘The Greatest Showman’ and went viral after it was reported that she did many of her own trapeze stunts in the film.Her role as Rue Bennett in ‘Euphoria’ made history in 2020 as she became the youngest recipient to win the Primetime Emmy for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series. She won the award yet again in 2022. Following this, she starred in a lot of blockbuster hits, including the ‘Dune’ franchise, 'Challengers,' ‘Malcolm & Marie,' the ‘Spider-Man’ franchise, and ‘The Drama.'Zendaya and Tom Holland’s relationship timelineHolland and Zendaya met for the first time during the filming of the first ‘Spider-Man’ film, and right from the beginning they became close friends. Right from the start, rumors of the two being in a relationship started circulating; however, for the next couple of years, the two maintained that they were nothing more than good friends. In 2021, however, paparazzi photographed the co-stars sharing a kiss in a car in Los Angeles. Later that year, Holland publicly acknowledged their relationship in a GQ interview, sharing that they felt "robbed of their privacy." Since then, the two have maintained that their relationship is their private business and that they do not wish to share any aspect of it with the public.Around 2024, after attending events together on multiple occasions, Holland proposed to the ‘Shake It Up’ singer in an intimate, low-key setting over the 2024 holiday season. Zendaya made the engagement public when she debuted her diamond ring at the 2025 Golden Globes, sending fans of the couple into a frenzy. Since earlier this year, there have been rumors of the two getting married in a private ceremony, which were started by Law Roach, Zendaya’s designer, who had earlier shared that the two had already gotten married.Since then, Zendaya has not shared any statements about the topic.
